Journeys we love to plan

Starting points, not packages carved in stone. Every one of these is shaped around your dates, your pace, and who you're travelling with.

Cruise7 nights

Caribbean by Sea

The classic first cruise, done properly — the right ship for your style, a cabin position that suits how you sleep, and port days planned before you sail.

  • Eastern or Western Caribbean routes
  • Shore days matched to your interests, not the crowd's
  • Pre- and post-cruise hotel nights arranged

Best months: December to April for the driest weather

Cruise + land9–12 days

Greek Isles & the Aegean

Sail it, then stay in it. A Greek Isles cruise paired with extra nights in Athens and Santorini, so the islands aren't just a four-hour port call.

  • Athens and the Acropolis before you embark
  • Santorini, Mykonos, Rhodes and Crete
  • Caldera-view stays in Oia or Fira

Best months: May, June and September for warm seas and thinner crowds

Cruise7 nights

Alaska's Inside Passage

Glaciers, fjords, and frontier towns from the comfort of a balcony. We help you pick between Glacier Bay and Hubbard Glacier routes — it matters more than the ship does.

  • Juneau, Skagway, Ketchikan and glacier cruising
  • Whale watching and dog-sledding excursions
  • Optional Denali land add-on by rail

Best months: Late May to early September — the full cruise season

Island escape5–10 nights

Maldives, Slowly

Overwater villa or beach bungalow? Seaplane or speedboat? The Maldives rewards good advice — transfers, meal plans, and house reefs make or break the trip.

  • Resort matched to your style: quiet, diving, or family
  • Transfers and meal plans sorted up front
  • Pairs well with a stopover in Doha, Dubai or Singapore

Best months: November to April, the dry northeast monsoon

Island + coast6–8 days

Riviera Maya & Cenote Country

Split your stay between the Caribbean coast and the interior: beach days in the Riviera Maya, then cenotes, ruins, and Mérida's food scene inland.

  • Tulum and the Sian Ka'an biosphere
  • Cenote route: swim, lunch, repeat
  • Easy pairing with a Western Caribbean cruise

Best months: November to April, outside sargassum season's peak

A land package is a journey pieced together for you — hotels, transfers, tours and experiences arranged in the right order, at a pace that suits you, instead of a fixed package off the shelf. Tell us where you'd like to go and we'll build it piece by piece.

Tailor-made journeys

The land journeys already on this site are the template: Riviera Maya & Cenote Country, beach days paired with cenotes, ruins and Mérida's food scene; Greek Isles & the Aegean, with Athens and Santorini stays around the sailing; and Alaska's Inside Passage, where a Denali land add-on by rail turns a cruise into a bigger trip.

Built piece by piece

Hotels in the right neighbourhood, private or small-group tours, transfers that line up with your flights, and experiences booked ahead — assembled into one itinerary with realistic timings, so the trip runs smoothly from arrival to departure.

Amtrak rail journeys

See North America by train. OCL can arrange Amtrak rail journeys, including Amtrak Vacations packages that combine the rail journey with hotels and sightseeing along the route — a relaxed way to cross the country or link great cities in one trip.

Disney holidays

OCL can arrange Disney holidays too — Walt Disney World in Florida, Disneyland in California, and Disney Cruise Line sailings — with the resort or stateroom, park days and details planned around your family.

Get a tailored quote

Land packages are quoted trip by trip — start with the trip-brief builder, or contact us at book@ocltravel.com or +1 (305) 814-7009 and we'll put together a quote for your dates.

Questions, answered straight

Does it cost more to book through an agency?

Usually not. Cruise lines and most hotels pay agencies a commission out of the price you'd pay booking direct, so the fare you see is typically the same — with an advisor's planning on top. If a planning fee applies to a complex custom itinerary, you'll know before any work starts.

How far ahead should I start planning?

For cruises and peak-season trips, 6–12 months out gets you the best cabin and room choices. Alaska and the Greek Isles reward early booking most. That said, good trips come together in a few weeks too — the brief takes two minutes, so start it whenever.

Can you book just part of a trip?

Yes. Plenty of travellers book their own flights and ask us for the cruise, the land itinerary, or the tricky transfers in between. Tell us what you've already arranged in the brief and we'll build around it.

What if something goes wrong while I'm travelling?

You call us, not a call centre. We rebook, reroute, and deal with suppliers while you get on with your day — that's a large part of what an agency is for.

Do I need travel insurance?

We recommend it for almost every trip, especially cruises and international travel — medical cover abroad and cancellation protection are the two pieces that matter most. We'll explain the options that fit your trip; the choice is always yours.

Terms & Conditions

The terms that apply when you plan and book travel through OCL Travel.

Who we are

OCL Travel is the trading name of Ocean Crown & Latitudes Travel LLC, based in Florida. We operate through our host agency, Travel Planners International — advisor ID TPI-3008.

We act as your agent

OCL Travel acts as an agent for travel suppliers. When we make a booking for you, your contract for the travel itself is with the supplier — for example the cruise line, hotel, or other provider named on your booking — and that booking is subject to the supplier's own terms and conditions, which apply alongside these terms.

Prices

Prices we quote are based on the supplier's price at the time of the quote and can change until your trip is booked and paid for in line with the supplier's requirements. We will confirm the price that applies before you commit to a booking.

Deposits, payments, cancellations and changes

Deposits, payment amounts and deadlines, and the terms for cancellations and changes, follow the policy of the supplier for your booking. We will explain the deposit, payment schedule, and cancellation and change terms that apply to your trip before you book, and we will pass on any supplier charges that apply if you later cancel or change your booking.

Travel insurance

Travel insurance is strongly recommended for every trip, in particular for cruises and international travel. We can explain the options that fit your trip; whether to take cover, and the level of cover you choose, is your decision.

Passports, visas and entry requirements

Passports, visas and all other entry requirements for the places you visit are your responsibility as the traveller. Please make sure your documents are valid and meet each destination's requirements before you travel — we are happy to talk through what to check when you book.

Contact us about these terms

For bookings and questions about these terms, contact us at book@ocltravel.com or call +1 (305) 814-7009.

Privacy Policy

What this site collects, and what we do — and don't do — with it.

What we collect

When you use this site, we collect the details you choose to share with us:

  • Your name, email address, phone number and trip details when you use the trip-brief builder and send us your brief.
  • Your email address when you use the special-offers signup on this site or in the chat assistant.

This site also uses Google Analytics to help us understand how visitors use it. Google Analytics collects anonymous usage information — such as the pages visited, your approximate location, and your device and browser type — but no names, email addresses or other personal details. You can opt out through your browser settings or by using Google's Analytics opt-out add-on.

How we use it

We use the details you share only to plan and book your trips, to respond to your enquiries, and — where you have signed up for them — to send you the special offers you asked for.

We never sell your details

We never sell your personal details. We share details with travel suppliers only as needed to make and manage the bookings you ask us to arrange.

Questions about privacy

If you have any questions about this policy or about the details we hold for you, contact us at info@ocltravel.com.
